reviews.text: My husband & I now never have to leave our home again thanks to Zac & his team building an oasis steps from our back door! Zac & his entire crew were fantastic to work with and super communicative throughout the entire process. When we initially decided to build a pool we reached out to 4 different contractors & not only was Zac quick to respond and answer all of our questions, he was also able to make our wants & needs list happen within our budget (another company quoted us $40k more and that did not include landscaping!). Overall, a 10/10 experience that we would highly recommend to anyone considering any major outdoor renovations!!
reviews.author: Allie Thomas

reviews.text: I have been using exclusive for pool service for years. Hunter was always good. Monday they had a new employee doing service. He didn’t add water to the level. Came home from an errand on Thursday and pumps were burned up. This is going to cost me thousands of dollars. I spoke with Zach and he blamed me and took no responsibility. Said that was on me   I am an ex Pentair employee and called my pool counterparts at Pentair. They said it’s obvious any pool service company should be adding water when coming out when they clean out strainer baskets etc. I told zach I would buy the pumps but felt they should acknowledge their part by installing them for free. He said no and the new employee had nothing to do with my lack of caring for my pool. I thought that’s why I paid exclusive $216 a month. I would never ever recommend exclusive. I find it highly suspect that after having used them for years my pumps burned up 3 days after a new employee services my pool and they bear no responsibility.
reviews.author: Gary Davis

reviews.text:
After buying a new home w a complicated pool and many features, we interviewed multiple pool service companies. None of them were able to  find/fix our issues, until we were referred to Exclusive pool and patio, they not only found the issue with our heater but repaired it the next day and  were reasonably priced. We like that they are full service and will now do our weekly maintenance.

Our technician Miller had extensive knowledge in this industry and trained us on the equipment usage which was a huge plus.

Fast, friendly and professional people at this company who go the extra mile to take great care of their customers and in a timely fashion.
reviews.author: Lara Shankle

reviews.text: This company has been fantastic to work with. They responded quickly when I reached out, offered great value for the work they did, and the work happened when they said it would. I'm very impressed and would easily recommend them to friends and family. I had them do a patio extension, travertine tiles, outdoor kitchen and artificial turf for my outdoor living area. I couldn't be happier.
reviews.author: Cody McCain

reviews.text: These guys are great! We had another maintenance company set up but they never showed up when they were scheduled and when they did show up they did a half-ass job. Zack and his team (Hunter) always show up on time and spend the time to make sure my pool is sparkling before they leave (see photo). I would highly recommended Exclusive  Pool and Patio to anyone in need of pool services.
reviews.author: Jeff Burttschell

reviews.text: Great team. They do amazing work. I’ve worked with Zac and Parker for a while on many projects and they’re always great to work with.
reviews.author: Chris Bowen

reviews.text: Exclusive Pool and Patio did an excellent job for us with a multitude of items we needed taken care of with our pool & spa and the equipment. They were professional, courteous, and prompt with both quoting the job and doing the work. Their pricing was more than fair and everything was itemized and explained very clearly. I would highly recommend them for any pool needs!
reviews.author: Maryanne Jolley

reviews.text: We had Exclusive build our pool last winter and now they maintain it weekly for us. Quality build with great and timely service and keeps my pool running in tip top shape.
reviews.author: Paige Bell

reviews.text: Blocking street for a long time. Do better. Edit: at least they acknowledged it and mentioned they are going to do better. Bumped up to 4 stars for responding properly.
reviews.author: Casey

reviews.text: They built my pool and outdoor kitchen and fireplace. They did excellent work and my guests rave about how great it looks.  Now Michael Miller from the company does my weekly pool service and he goes above and beyond to make sure my pool is always in great shape. Thanks Mike!
reviews.author: Rebecca Bales

reviews.text: We have been very happy with the pool service we receive every week. It is also, a very reasonable price!
reviews.author: Robin Hodges

reviews.text: Michael Miller is the BEST pool tech we've ever had!  He's very nice, professional, and always on time.  Our pool is in the best shape ever thanks to him!
reviews.author: Ellen Fair Terrell

reviews.text: Michael Miller is fantastic. He has been cleaning our pool and doing a variety of maintenance the last 20 months or so. Wouldn't want anyone else. Great job to Michael, Zac and the team at EP&P. 10 stars!!
reviews.author: paul krause

reviews.text: Exclusive Pool and Patio blew me away! I received a consult from 6 companies to add turf trim to my pool deck. Exclusive was the best from the beginning. They finished quickly, communicated often and we're such a wonderful company to work with. The quality of work is excellent and I would recommend them to anyone who asks!
reviews.author: Melissa Weiss

reviews.text:
We loved working with these guys. The team is great, works extremely hard, and did an amazing job. We couldn't be happier with how things turned out with a new outdoor cooking area, concrete deck, flower beds, and raised planters. They did an amazing job with everything.

Also - the breaker/circuit that went to our laundry room needed to be replaced and while the electrician was here he noticed it and fixed it for us. No questions asked, just said he saw it and wanted us to have it working again. Saved me a bunch of time/energy/expense and he was extremely gracious about it. It's wonderful working with people like this!
reviews.author: Connor Schaars

reviews.text: Frank and Zach were great to work with!  They listened to us and worked to create a beautiful design that was within our budget.  The project stayed on track and they accommodated every request along the way.  We are very happy with the pool and look forward to many years of enjoyment with our family!
reviews.author: Marty Peery

reviews.text: We had a pool and spa built by Exclusive Pool and Patio. The process went very smoothly and our project was completed on time. Exclusive was professional, responsive and great at communicating every step of the way. The suggestions they made on the pool design were perfect and we are so happy we went with Exclusive. We love our pool & spa! It's been almost a year and a half now since our pool was completed and we've had zero issues. Highly recommend Exclusive!
reviews.author: Esther Hong

reviews.text: Zac was easy to work with. His attention to detail is top notch!  If you have a current pool or want to get a new one built Exclusive Pool and Patio is who you need to call.  We have done several projects with him and he never disappoints the customer.  Nothing but the best is provided by Exclusive Pool and Patio.
reviews.author: Nick Ogilvie

reviews.text: At Luxe Blades NTX we have the opportunity to work with Exclusive Pool and Patio on a regular basis. They are fair and honest and they provide an exceptional product along with the communication our shared clients are looking for from beginning to end of the job. We highly recommend them for your backyard patio, pool, and concrete needs!
reviews.author: Holly Haven

reviews.text: Zac and Frank are phenomenal. They designed our pool within our requested budget and completed the project within the timeframe that was originally set. We had no issues worth mentioning throughout the process and the final product exceeded our expectations. Zac and Frank were available every step of the way. They clearly explained the processes and were quick to answer any questions that arose. In addition to them being accessible, they both went out of their way to reach out to provide the latest updates or even just to check in. We highly recommend Exclusive Pool and Patio – and thank them for an amazing backyard/pool area that we use as much as we possibly can.
reviews.author: Eric Brandt

reviews.text: Zach had his team built our pool and have maintained it for several years.  The team has always performed excellent service.
reviews.author: Randy Gros

reviews.text: We ❤️ Exclusive Pool & Patio!!  We have a small backyard that was just a dog area. Zac and team helped us design and build a great pool and patio that we will enjoy year round.
reviews.author: Ron Fellhauer

reviews.text: Zac made this experience painless. I highly recommend.  He does the little things that separate his business from all the others.  The well known titans in the business here locally are unwilling or unable to offer the same responsiveness and the fly-by businesses care about getting your money and you'll never hear from them again.
reviews.author: Curtis Potucek

reviews.text: Needed some quick attention before a pool disaster, and Zach made it happen! Worked us into the day, and quickly diagnosed the issue and resolved it.  Thankful not to have a burned up motor!!! Thank you!!!!
reviews.author: Stephanie Allam

reviews.text: Exclusive did a great job (on my patio) estimating the project (with no surprises!) and getting the work done on schedule.  I am considering hiring them again for upcoming projects.
reviews.author: Dev Shafeek

reviews.text: Zach is awesome to work with! His team is great and their attention to detail is unmatched!
reviews.author: Chris Bowen

reviews.text: Job was done right on time for a fair price. Can’t complain about that. Keep up the good work guys.
reviews.author: Brian B.

reviews.text: Repaired my pool equipment same day I called. Fast and reliable, Exclusive will be the only company I call for pool repairs!
reviews.author: Justin Villa

reviews.text:
Hunter has been absolutely amazing, great with communication on when he is coming and status of the pool.

Our pool always looks nice and clean, thanks to Hunter!
reviews.author: Sean Foglia

reviews.text: Miller and the guys are great at keeping my pool looking nice and clean. Highly recommend their services. Professional and always on time!!
reviews.author: Rick Russell

reviews.text:
I would not recommend this company to service your regular pool needs.

We tried to work with our pool tech for several weeks and our situation continued to decline. Unfortunately, our pool was not properly maintained.
reviews.author: Emily Davis

reviews.text: Thank you for identifying and fixing my pool pump is such an expedited manor! Everyone is always so nice and helpful!
reviews.author: Tricia Bayless

reviews.text: Zac and team have been very responsive with my backyard needs!
reviews.author: Laurel Kiehl

reviews.text: My pool looks great! Would definitely recommend!
reviews.author: Debbie Buck

reviews.text: Set a day for them to come out and he didn’t even show up when I tried reaching out was ignored
reviews.author: Veronica Gutierrez

reviews.text: Good work and took the time to explain the work completed

reviews.text: Pool cleaning service is amazing, thank you!

reviews.text: Great company.

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic. The positive reviews contain specific details about employees, projects, and outcomes. The negative reviews present credible, specific complaints (e.g., pump burnout, no-shows) that align with common service industry issues. There is a healthy mix of perspectives, and the volume of reviews is appropriate for a 5-year-old business. No patterns suggest review manipulation.
authentic_signals: Specific employee names and project details
Mix of praise and specific complaints
Emotionally authentic language in both positive and negative reviews
Owner responses to negative feedback (implied by edited review)
complaint_patterns: Service error leading to equipment damage
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistent across platforms. Google (4.7) and Yelp (4.1) are in close alignment, which is typical as Yelp often has fewer reviews and a different user base. The BBB A+ rating indicates good complaint handling.
